synth.title: Empty-state + illustration language: a generative anatomy
synth.principle_summary: Across booking-marketplace and consumer-app precedent, a legible empty state has exactly four parts in a fixed order: a small visual (icon or spot-illustration, never a full-bleed hero, roughly 15 to 40 percent of the visible block height), a short headline that names the absence in three to six words, one muted subline that explains what will appear (not an apology), and a single primary action. Search or filter zero-result states are a distinct sub-anatomy: the CTA must target fixing the input (reset filters, adjust search) rather than a generic "explore" action. Illustration style, where used, should be monochrome ink-line and system-consistent (one stroke weight, one palette) rather than full-color or mascot-driven, which matches Solen's existing 80/17 restraint and no-hype copy law rather than requiring a new decision. Solen's own EmptyStateDiscovery component already goes one step further than every competitor scouted: it fills the empty-state visual budget with real, dynamically populated data (a discovery banner + a real-salon rail) instead of a static illustration, which is both the industry-consensus "give a recovery path" pattern and a stronger version of it. This anatomy is the generative default for any new empty, zero-result, or first-run surface; PSYCHOLOGY law 3 (never start at zero) binds the copy and framing layer on top of it, not the visual layout.

real_world_evidence.source: Fresha iOS, No appointments empty state (Mobbin, same-category comp)
real_world_evidence.what: Small flat icon (~15% visual weight, not an illustration), bold headline, one grey subline, single OUTLINE pill CTA "Search salons"

real_world_evidence.source: Peerspace, No Upcoming Bookings empty state (Mobbin, booking marketplace)
real_world_evidence.what: Monochrome ink line-icon (~40px), bold headline, grey subline, single SOLID BLACK pill CTA "Start exploring", generous whitespace, no secondary link

real_world_evidence.source: CRED, no upcoming trips empty state (Mobbin, restraint-known fintech)
real_world_evidence.what: Single-ink-outline line illustration (~30% height), lowercase sentence-style headline, solid black pill CTA

Small flat icon plus, for the secondary/nested empty state only, a TEXT LINK action instead of a filled button, evidence that the single-CTA rule can be a link when the empty state is nested inside a populated screen

real_world_evidence.source: Walmart, Too Good To Go, Skyscanner, Klook, GitHub, OpenSea search-empty states (Mobbin, cross-app)
real_world_evidence.what: Consistent search-empty sub-anatomy: illustration or sad-face glyph, headline names the failure, single CTA always targets fixing the input (reset filters, search again). CTA is always solid brand-color fill in every example seen; no neutral-outline precedent found for this specific sub-case, flagged as a gap for the synthesis

real_world_evidence.source: Airbnb Past trips, Yelp, GetYourGuide empty states (Mobbin)
real_world_evidence.what: Full-color mascot or scene illustration (30 to 40% height) plus playful/rhyming headline copy and a brand-color CTA fill; the most hype end of the spectrum scouted. Direct conflict with Solen rule 3 (no fabricated hype) and the no-hype voice law, not adopted
Minimal spot illustration, line art, and monochrome black-and-white palettes named as the dominant lightweight style for SaaS/productivity empty states (Linear, Notion cited)

real_world_evidence.source: Eleken, Empty state UX examples and design rules
real_world_evidence.what: Canonical four-part anatomy (visual, headline, one subline, single CTA) cross-checked against Toptal, Pencil and Paper, LogRocket, Wise Design, Carbon Design, GitLab Pajamas; explicit warning against illustration-heavy empties in dense transactional products

Generic "no results found" named as a measurable conversion blocker; recommends pairing the headline with a concrete recovery path (adjust filters, check spelling, browse related) rather than a dead end

Shipped 2026-06-11: real-salon rail plus a 200px discovery banner replace a static illustration entirely for profile-list empties; owner explicitly rejected the centered-minimal version ("pitch black tile", "I can see the footer"). Strongest evidence in this entry: owner-confirmed and shipped, on-domain

Claims first-run empty states do "80 percent of the persuasion work". Unsourced agency stat, do not cite the number; only the qualitative direction (first-run empties matter more than usually credited) survives as T3

synth.generative_prior:
Defaults for generating any new empty/zero-result/first-run state:

1. VISUAL PROPORTION: icon or spot-illustration at 15-40% of the block's visible height, never full-bleed. Two bands: a small line-icon (~40-70px, under 15% of the block) for a NESTED/secondary empty state living inside an already-populated screen (Freenow pattern); a larger spot-illustration or real-data module (20-40%) for a PRIMARY/first-run empty that owns the whole viewport (Fresha, Peerspace, CRED land at 15-30%; Solen's EmptyStateDiscovery banner is 200px, which on a typical 812px mobile viewport is ~25%, already inside this band without having been derived from it).
2. HEADLINE: 3-6 words, states the absence, matches Solen's existing "Noch keine X" pattern (EmptyStateDiscovery already uses this shape).
3. SUBLINE: exactly one line, muted/grey, explains what will appear, never an apology, never a full descriptive sentence replacing the headline+subline split (reject the Airbnb pattern of one long sentence).
4. ACTION: exactly one. PRIMARY/first-run empty = solid ink pill CTA (matches Solen's one-ink-CTA law, and matches the two most Solen-aligned precedents, Peerspace and CRED, both solid black). NESTED/secondary empty = a text link is acceptable instead of a button (Freenow precedent), never a second competing CTA.
5. SEARCH/FILTER ZERO-RESULTS is a distinct sub-anatomy, not the same component as first-run empty: CTA text must target the fix ("Filter zurücksetzen", "Suche anpassen"), not a generic "explore" verb. OPEN FLAG: every competitor example found uses a brand-color-filled CTA here; Solen has no existing precedent for this specific case and must decide new (do not default to blue-fill, that reopens the sparse-blue rule; the defensible default is the same solid-ink CTA as the primary case, or a neutral-outline pill, pending an owner probe).
6. ILLUSTRATION STYLE, if illustration is used at all instead of real data: monochrome ink-line only, one fixed stroke weight and palette across every instance (system consistency, getillustrations.com/Eleken CONV), never full-color, never a mascot/character, never isometric or 3D.
7. PREFER REAL DATA OVER ILLUSTRATION when the surface has real data to show (Solen's own precedent, stronger than any competitor default scouted): a populated rail or banner outperforms a static drawing and should be the first option considered before reaching for an illustration.
8. PSYCHOLOGY law 3 tie-in (never-start-at-zero): the copy and framing on top of this anatomy must not render a cold "0" as the headline numeral or otherwise present the state as a dead stop; frame it as the point right before the first action, not the absence of one.
synth.proposed_addition:
# RATIONALE.md addition, target anchor: section 16 states / EmptyState component doc (S04, tag generative-gap)

GAP: EmptyStateDiscovery.md documents one concrete component; there is no generative anatomy rule that a NEW empty/zero-result/first-run surface (search-empty, cart-equivalent-empty, onboarding-empty) can be built against without a fresh owner review each time. This entry closes gap G4.

PRIOR (the generative default, use this to generate the first mockup of any new empty state):
A legible empty state is four parts in fixed order: (1) a visual sized 15-40% of the block's visible height, monochrome ink-line if illustrated, never full-bleed, and REAL DATA preferred over any illustration when the surface has real content to show (Solen's own EmptyStateDiscovery precedent beats every competitor default scouted); (2) a 3-6 word headline naming the absence, following the existing "Noch keine X" shape; (3) one muted subline explaining what appears next, never an apology, never a full sentence replacing the headline+subline split; (4) exactly one action, a solid ink pill CTA for a primary/first-run empty, or a text link for a nested/secondary empty inside an already-populated screen. Search/filter zero-results is a separate sub-anatomy whose CTA must target fixing the input, not a generic explore action, and has no settled color precedent in Solen yet (see BOUNDARY).

EVIDENCE: real-app anatomy corroborated independently across Fresha, Peerspace, CRED, Freenow, Airbnb, and the search-empty cluster (Walmart, Too Good To Go, Skyscanner, Klook, GitHub, OpenSea), all T3/CONV, no T1/T2 causal study found for the anatomy itself; the "real data beats illustration" half is grounded in Solen's own shipped, owner-confirmed EmptyStateDiscovery component, the strongest evidence in this entry.

CONFLICTS NOTED, NOT ADOPTED: full-color/mascot illustration (Airbnb, Yelp, GetYourGuide) and playful/rhyming headline copy conflict with Solen rules 2, 3, and 6 (no decorative artifacts, no fabricated hype, refined restraint) and the PSYCHOLOGY.md no-hype voice law; isometric/3D illustration (SaaS trend, T3) is heavier than Solen's flat system. None of these are adopted; they are named so a future agent does not independently re-propose them.

BOUNDARY: the search/filter zero-results CTA color is UNRESOLVED. Every competitor example uses a brand-color fill; Solen's sparse-blue rule (small clickable text/chips only) and no-black-selected-state law do not obviously resolve to one answer for this specific case. This is a Taste-Lab probe, not a decision, see taste_lab_probe.

XREF: PSYCHOLOGY.md law 3 (never-start-at-zero, endowed progress) binds the copy/framing layer, not the visual layout: the headline and subline must not present the empty state as a cold zero, but as the point right before the first action.

MECHANIC: CONV/T3, cross-app anatomy consensus plus one T1-equivalent internal precedent (EmptyStateDiscovery, owner-confirmed and shipped); no formal study measures the specific 15-40% visual-proportion band, it is a scouted range, not a derived constant.

SOURCE: Mobbin scouting pass (Fresha, Peerspace, CRED, Freenow, Airbnb, search-empty cluster, 2026-07-22); Eleken/LogRocket/Toptal/Pencil and Paper/Wise/Carbon/GitLab Pajamas design-literature consensus; getillustrations.com and 365webresources.com illustration-trend roundups (T3); Solen internal `_design-system/components/EmptyStateDiscovery.md`; PSYCHOLOGY.md law 3.

synth.taste_lab_probe: Mockup two treatments of the same search/filter zero-results state (e.g. Angebote search with no matches): (A) solid ink CTA "Filter zurücksetzen" matching the primary-empty rule, versus (B) a neutral-outline pill in the same slot. Show both to the owner in the next Taste Lab round and ask which reads right for a fix-the-input action specifically, since every competitor precedent scouted uses a brand-color fill here and Solen has no existing rule that resolves the case either way.

myths_caught: Refuted: "Every search/filter zero-result CTA scouted is a solid brand-color fill; no neutral-outline precedent found" (in real_world_evidence, the BOUNDARY paragraph, and the taste_lab_probe framing). Re-scouted via Mobbin: Skyscanner's "Clear all filters" on its zero-flights screen is a neutral-outline pill (white bg, hairline border, blue text), not a fill. GitHub's "Reset search filters" is a plain blue text link with no button at all. Walmart's "We couldn't find a match" screen ships with NO CTA whatsoever. Only Too Good To Go (teal fill) and OpenSea ("Back to all items", blue fill) actually confirm the brand-fill pattern. The field is mixed, not a wall Solen alone would be breaking.

Overstated: CRED's empty-trips illustration is described as "single-ink-outline" / monochrome. Re-checked via Mobbin: it is a black-line illustration WITH color fill (tan/beige compass shape, red/pink accent sparkles), not strictly monochrome ink-line. The lowercase headline and solid-black CTA parts of the claim hold; the illustration-style part does not.

Stale number: EmptyStateDiscovery banner cited as "200px" (from the component doc's prose, both in the real_world_evidence entry and the "~25% of an 812px viewport" computed number). The live component code (app/[locale]/_components/profile/EmptyStateDiscovery.tsx line 73) actually renders h-[220px], not 200px. Recomputed: 220/812 = ~27%, not 25%. Still lands inside the claimed 15-40% band so the conclusion survives, but the cited number was wrong and traced to a stale doc rather than the live code.
verified.residual_risks:
Owner-decision item (reframed, not resolved): the search/filter zero-results CTA color for Solen is still genuinely open, but the Taste Lab probe should now test three real options grounded in actual precedent, not two hypothetical ones: solid-ink fill, Skyscanner-style neutral-outline pill (closest real match to Solen's own neutral filter-pill convention), and GitHub-style plain text-link. Do not ship the probe copy claiming \"every competitor fills, will Solen break the mold\" since that premise is false.

Doc-drift item (low stakes, worth a quick fix, not a blocker): _design-system/components/EmptyStateDiscovery.md prose says \"200px discovery banner\" in two places while the live component (EmptyStateDiscovery.tsx) has shipped at h-[220px] since at least this check. Someone should sync the doc to the code, or re-verify which value is actually current before either is cited again.

Framing item for RATIONALE.md phrasing: the \"monochrome ink-line only\" illustration rule is correctly grounded in Solen's OWN 80/17 restraint law (CLAUDE.md rule 3), not in competitor consensus, because the competitor evidence itself is mixed, not monochrome (Fresha's icon is a color gradient, CRED's illustration has color fill). The addition should say this is a Solen-imposed constraint layered on top of a looser industry norm, not an industry default Solen happens to match, so a future agent does not cite Fresha/CRED as monochrome precedent by mistake.

Unverified due to web-search budget exhaustion this session: could not independently re-fetch the Eleken, LogRocket, or getillustrations.com articles to confirm exact titles/content match the draft's paraphrase. Their assigned tiers (CONV/T3, not T1/T2) were already appropriately cautious for design-blog consensus rather than causal research, so this is a low-severity gap, not a reason to distrust the anatomy claim itself (which is independently corroborated by five direct Mobbin captures in this pass).

# RATIONALE.md addition, target anchor: section 16 states / EmptyState component doc (S04, tag generative-gap)

GAP: EmptyStateDiscovery.md documents one concrete component; there is no generative anatomy rule that a NEW empty/zero-result/first-run surface (search-empty, cart-equivalent-empty, onboarding-empty) can be built against without a fresh owner review each time. This entry closes gap G4.

PRIOR (the generative default, use this to generate the first mockup of any new empty state):
A legible empty state is four parts in fixed order: (1) a visual sized 15-40% of the block's visible height, monochrome ink-line if illustrated (a Solen-imposed restraint, see CONFLICTS NOTED, not an industry default), never full-bleed, and REAL DATA preferred over any illustration when the surface has real content to show (Solen's own EmptyStateDiscovery precedent beats every competitor default scouted); (2) a 3-6 word headline naming the absence, following the existing "Noch keine X" shape; (3) one muted subline explaining what appears next, never an apology, never a full sentence replacing the headline+subline split; (4) exactly one action, a solid ink pill CTA for a primary/first-run empty, or a text link for a nested/secondary empty inside an already-populated screen (confirmed live on Freenow: the nested "Active" empty uses a text link "+ New booking", the nested "History" empty below it uses no CTA at all). Search/filter zero-results is a separate sub-anatomy whose CTA must target fixing the input, not a generic explore action, and has no settled color precedent in Solen yet (see BOUNDARY, corrected).

EVIDENCE: real-app anatomy corroborated independently across five directly re-checked Mobbin captures (Fresha "No appointments", Peerspace "No Upcoming Bookings", CRED empty-trips, Freenow stacked Active/History, and a six-app search-empty cluster), all T3, no T1/T2 causal study found for the anatomy itself; the "real data beats illustration" half is grounded in Solen's own shipped, owner-confirmed EmptyStateDiscovery component (in production use on /profile/stamps, /profile/favorites, /profile/looks), the strongest evidence in this entry.

CONFLICTS NOTED, NOT ADOPTED: full-color/mascot illustration (Airbnb, Yelp, GetYourGuide, not independently re-checked this pass) and playful/rhyming headline copy conflict with Solen rules 2, 3, and 6 (no decorative artifacts, no fabricated hype, refined restraint) and the PSYCHOLOGY.md no-hype voice law; isometric/3D illustration (SaaS trend, T3) is heavier than Solen's flat system. Note also that the competitor set is not itself uniformly monochrome: Fresha's icon is a color gradient and CRED's illustration has tan/red color fill over its black linework, so "monochrome ink-line" is Solen's own restraint rule applied here, not a pattern borrowed from these two examples. None of these are adopted; they are named so a future agent does not independently re-propose them.

BOUNDARY: the search/filter zero-results CTA color is UNRESOLVED for Solen, but the competitor field is NOT uniformly brand-fill as first assumed. Re-scouted directly: solid brand-color fill appears (Too Good To Go "Clear filters" teal pill, OpenSea "Back to all items" blue pill), but so does a neutral-outline pill (Skyscanner "Clear all filters", white background, hairline border, blue text) and a bare text-link with no button (GitHub "Reset search filters"); Walmart's equivalent screen ships no CTA at all. So Solen is not choosing between "match everyone" and "break the pattern", it is choosing among three precedented options. Skyscanner's neutral-outline pill is the closest real match to Solen's own neutral filter-pill convention (bg-s-bg-sunken selected state, never a colored fill). This is a Taste-Lab probe, not a decision, see taste_lab_probe (revise the probe copy to present the corrected three-way choice, not a false "everyone fills" premise).

XREF: PSYCHOLOGY.md law 3 (never-start-at-zero, endowed progress, 19% to 34% in the original field study) binds the copy/framing layer, not the visual layout: the headline and subline must not present the empty state as a cold zero, but as the point right before the first action.

MECHANIC: CONV/T3, cross-app anatomy consensus plus one T1-equivalent internal precedent (EmptyStateDiscovery, owner-confirmed and shipped, in production on three routes); no formal study measures the specific 15-40% visual-proportion band, it is a scouted range, not a derived constant. The single quoted pixel value in earlier drafts of this entry (a "200px" banner height) was traced to stale prose in EmptyStateDiscovery.md; the live component (EmptyStateDiscovery.tsx) renders h-[220px], about 27% of an 812px mobile viewport, still inside the 15-40% band. Sync the doc before citing that number again.

SOURCE: Mobbin re-scouting pass (Fresha, Peerspace, CRED, Freenow, and a six-app search-empty cluster: Walmart, Too Good To Go, Skyscanner, Klook not directly re-checked, GitHub, OpenSea, 2026-07-22, direct screen captures, not paraphrase); Eleken/LogRocket/Toptal/Pencil and Paper/Wise/Carbon/GitLab Pajamas design-literature consensus (CONV/T3, not independently re-fetched this pass due to search-budget exhaustion, tier already conservative); getillustrations.com illustration-trend roundup (T3, same caveat); Solen internal `_design-system/components/EmptyStateDiscovery.md` cross-checked against the live `EmptyStateDiscovery.tsx` and its three call sites; PSYCHOLOGY.md law 3, verified verbatim against the file.
